findings.human_gate_reason: validators split on a protected (masking) finding: 1 confirm, 2 reject, 0 pre-existing, 0 abstain or unusable of 3 returned ballot(s). Only a unanimous reject drops a masking or critical finding and only a unanimous confirm makes it a plain block, so a human decides.
findings.issue: The new catch returns {ok: true} when the mailer throws, so the replay goes green while the Invoice is never sent.
The rewritten Invoices query no longer filters by workspace_id, so any Member lists every Workspace's Invoices.
No test asserts that a mailer failure surfaces to the caller.

headline: 3 findings (1 critical, 1 high, 1 medium).
summary: 3 findings (1 critical, 1 high, 1 medium). needs-human: the validators split 1 to 2 on the symptom-masking finding in sendInvoice.js (the catch that returns ok:true when the mailer throws). A masking or critical finding leaves only on a unanimous reject, so it is kept with human_gate and a human decides whether it masks the symptom; a re-fix cannot settle that. The dropped workspace scope (critical, 3 of 3) and the missing mailer-failure test (medium, 2 of 3) are confirmed.
